# [PR #410] feat: onboard Kimi K2.6 for mla_paged_decode_h8_ckv512_kpe64_ps1

source: https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer-bench/pull/410
state: open | updated: 2026-04-21T23:28:29Z
labels: 

## 正文

## Summary

Onboards `moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6` at tensor parallel size 8 to the Kimi-K2 MLA paged decode definition. Kimi K2.6 uses the same DeepSeek-V3-style MLA structure as Kimi K2 (`kv_lora_rank=512`, `qk_rope_head_dim=64`, `num_attention_heads=64` → 8 heads per device at TP=8), so the existing `mla_paged_decode_h8_ckv512_kpe64_ps1` definition applies without any schema change. This PR only adds a `model:kimi-k2.6` tag and updates coverage docs.

Reference run: SGLang offline Engine on `/models/Kimi-K2.6` with `tp_size=8, quantization=compressed-tensors, attention_backend=flashinfer` on 8× NVIDIA B200. Captured and sanitized MLA decode tensors land in the companion trace PR.

## Kernel details

| Axis | Value |
|---|---|
| `op_type` | `mla_paged` |
| `stage` | decode |
| `num_qo_heads` | 8 (64 / TP=8) |
| `head_dim_ckv` | 512 |
| `head_dim_kpe` | 64 |
| `page_size` | 1 |
| dtype | bfloat16 (Q/KV), float32 (sm_scale/LSE) |
| FlashInfer API | `flashinfer.mla.BatchMLAPagedAttentionWrapper` |
| Models (tags) | `model:kimi-k2`, `model:kimi-k2.6` |
| TP | 8 |

## Files changed

- `flashinfer_trace/definitions/mla_paged/mla_paged_decode_h8_ckv512_kpe64_ps1.json` — add `model:kimi-k2.6` tag; update description to mention both models.
- `docs/model_coverage.mdx`
  - Summary table: add a row for Kimi K2.6 (🟡 Partial).
  - Kimi K2 section: upgrade `mla_paged_decode_h8_ckv512_kpe64_ps1` from 🟡 → ✅ (workloads + baseline eval landed).
  - New dedicated Kimi K2.6 section at the bottom, documenting the shared MLA/MoE dimensions and the three missing `v=163840` sampling definitions.

No new reference test was added — the existing `flashinfer_trace/tests/references/test_mla_paged_decode_h8_ckv512_kpe64_ps1.py` covers this definition.
